action.rationale: Round 0 with budget 100 on a 10-D cheap, deterministic problem is below the 20·dim (200) threshold, so light probing (P1–P3) is warranted to reveal structure without burning budget.

Probes show global structure (P2 fdc_spearman = 0.636) but we lack P4/P5, and top10_spread_vs_uniform = 0.892 doesn’t clearly indicate a single clustered basin. With dim=10 and only 88 evals left, a short race (18% of total budget) between CMA-ES and TuRBO hedges and picks the better main method efficiently. The incumbent is 240.70 after 12 probe evals.

CMA-ES won the race with 204.763 after only 9 evals and is not converged (sigma=2.87, popsize=10), while P2 fdc=0.636 indicates useful global structure that favors a population method. With 70 evals left and stall_evals=12 coming from the brief race, continuing CMA-ES for a full round should yield further gains before polishing.

CMA-ES has stalled (stall_evals=62) with no improvement over 50 evals, and only 20 evals remain; this is end-of-budget. BOBYQA needs 2·dim+1=21 evaluations to start in 10D, so L-BFGS-B is the viable polisher from the incumbent y=204.763.

Only 9 evaluations remain (< round_size 50) and the active lbfgsb has exhausted; stall_evals is 73 with no improvement since eval 25. With so little budget left, further local methods (e.g., bobyqa needs ≥ 2·dim+1 = 21 evals) are unlikely to help.
